column1: ADBT is the average of final_settlement_date - due_date for fully settled invoices with period_start <= final_settlement_date <= report_date. final_settlement_date for an invoice with multiple payments is the earliest date on which cumulative payments sorted by date with same-day payments summed first reach or exceed the invoice amount
column2: later excess payments don't change it. A partially paid invoice is not eligible for ADBT. Preserve negative early-payment values and return null if none qualify.

column1: DSO is Average AR divided by Credit Sales times Days in Period, where Average AR equals opening AR plus closing AR divided by 2. Days in Period equals period_start through report_date inclusive when report_date is before period_end
column2: otherwise period_start through period_end inclusive. Credit sales are invoice amounts dated within the period and on or before report_date
column3: zero sales is null. opening_ar None falls back to zero with opening_ar_assumed true
column4: explicit Decimal zero does not set the flag.

column1: Overpayments yield zero invoice balance and per-invoice credit_balance
column2: display-only customer aggregates are excluded from total_outstanding.
